messages:
marco: Quick check: trying a tiny inline-edit pattern for reviewer rationale in compact prompt-eval rows. Idea: single-line editable pill with pencil icon, Enter saves draft, Ctrl+Enter approves. Keeps density + "why" visible.
anya: I like it. Visual affordance is key — a faint pencil + subtle focus ring. Users need to know it's editable.
zoe: For small screens, show a collapsed placeholder like 'Add reason' that expands to single-line input on focus. Keep it inline to avoid context switching.
drew: Bulk flow: if multiple items selected, show a small toolbar: [Add shared reason] [Apply per-item] [Confirm approval]. Apply-to-all should open a tiny modal to confirm.
a11y-bot: Accessibility nits:
- Inline edit must be a real input with aria-label `Edit reviewer note for diff {id}`.
- Announce saves with polite live region: `Reviewer note saved for diff {id}`.
- Approve announcement: `Approval confirmed for {n} items. Reviewer note preview: {summary}`. Ensure preview truncated by words.
marco: Microcopy options for placeholder: A) "Add a short reason (optional)" B) "Why accept?" C) "Reviewer note". Leaning to A for clarity.
anya: Keyboard hint: show micro hint on CTA focus: "Enter: add note, Ctrl+Enter: confirm" so people discover flow.
zoe: Small visual rule: reviewer text weight 600, model score 400 in compact rows so human intent stands out.
drew: Undo: show 8s snackbar with preview and Undo. Snackbar announcement should include note preview.
marco: Action items: Zoe -> two mocks (inline edit + collapsed), Drew -> proto keyboard mapping in storybook, Anya -> microcopy variants, a11y-bot -> final aria strings. Will run a 5-person keyboard-first test after.
marco: Thanks all, dropping figma link in PRD in a bit. :sparkles:
